svg.text: For disk.img, page number = block number.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: Because both are divided into 4096 bytes.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: When reading block 3 (tiny-fs's read_block(3)), what the kernel does has 2 stages.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif
Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: (2) Look up page 3 in disk.img's address_space index. If it is there, copy it and return; if empty, read from the device, put it in, then return.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif

svg.text: A different file means a different index, so disk.img's pages and /etc/hosts's pages never mix.
